description: Costs money. CloudGPU starts a GPU, runs one bash command on it, then destroys the GPU, all on its servers, so it finishes even if this assistant disconnects. max_spend_usd and max_hours are enforced by the servers. Retrying with the same idempotency_key never starts a second GPU; this tool generates one if you leave it out and returns it. The disk is erased when the job ends: the command must upload its own results (for example to the user's storage) or print them. Requires the user's explicit yes on the GPU, budget and time limit.

command.description: bash command or script to run on the GPU

disk_gb.description: Larger system disk: 100, 200 or 500; omit for the standard disk

gpu_model.description: GPU model exactly as list_gpus returns it

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same value when retrying the same job

max_hours.description: Hard time limit in hours (at most 24)

max_spend_usd.description: Budget for this job in USD (at most 50)

user_confirmed.description: true only if the user explicitly approved the GPU, budget and time limit

name: run_job
title: Run a job on a GPU
